title: Sample counter web page
summary: Synthetic practice project: a single web page showing a number that starts at 0, with Plus, Minus and Reset buttons.
outOfScope: Saving the number between page loads

acceptanceChecks.text: On first load the page shows the heading `Counter` and the value `0`.
Clicking the button labelled `Plus` three times makes the visible value `3`.
Clicking the button labelled `Minus` once after that makes the visible value `2`.
Clicking the button labelled `Reset` makes the visible value `0` again.
